versions.short: The bill would treat biosimilar biological products, which are medicines highly similar to an already approved reference product, as interchangeable with that product automatically, removing the separate interchangeability showing that manufacturers now must make. It would also start a short transition period, remove a requirement that biosimilar applications meet extra interchangeability standards, and adjust rules on pediatric testing and related federal drug laws. It would further let the health secretary update guidance on the data needed to show biosimilarity.
